description: Structured JSON extraction from unstructured text -- grounded in real, live verification, not just pattern-matching. Pulls requested fields, nulls anything missing, never guesses. Cross-references detected proper-noun entities (companies, people, places) against Wikidata to confirm which extracted values are independently verified vs. unconfirmed. SPENDS your balance — requires FD_API_KEY. Returns the extracted rows, what you were charged, and a proof_id.

document.description: The unstructured document text to extract from.

fields.description: The field names to extract, e.g. ["company_name", "ceo_name"].

max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to poll (default 60, agent typically takes ~30s). On timeout, returns task_id to poll later.

name: forcedream_extract_data
title: Extract structured fields from a document
